title.description: Poem title (Arabic). Used as the H1, page title, OG/JSON-LD name.

shortName.description: Optional short name for the PWA (defaults to title).

layout.description: single = one page (a Table of Contents appears for multi-section poems). paged = an index page + one page per ## chapter, with prev/next nav — use this for long works (alfiyyas).

domain.description: Bare custom domain host (no https://), e.g. "poem.example.com". Becomes CNAME + canonical URL.

showcase.description: Framework-internal (shatr demo only): also ship the showcase/ gallery at /showcase/. Leave unset for a normal poem site.

manifestDescription.description: Optional PWA manifest description (defaults to description).

signatureLine.description: Free-text date/place line shown under the first section's signature.

preset.description: Colour preset (light + dark palettes). Sets the page colours and PWA chrome. See engine/themes.json.

themeColor.description: Override the browser toolbar colour (defaults to the preset's).

splashColor.description: Override the PWA splash background (defaults to the preset's).

resources.description: Optional links. Each rendered as a card + a scroll button; omit to hide.

whatsapp.description: true = auto share text from title/author/url; or a custom string.

pdf.description: PDF filename placed in content/ (copied to the site root).

links.description: Extra same-tab link cards (e.g. a companion game on the same origin).

ga4.description: GA4 measurement id, e.g. G-XXXXXXX. Omit to ship zero analytics.

card.description: 1200x630 JPG in content/, used as og:image. If omitted, the 512 icon is used.

labels.description: Optional overrides for Arabic UI strings (listen, send, pdf, web …; and, for per-bayt tools: play, stop, meaning, meanings, hardWords, more, credits).

basePath.description: Where the site lives on the host, e.g. "/qasida/" when it is served at https://DOMAIN/qasida/. Every URL (canonical, OG, sitemap, manifest scope/start_url/icons, service-worker registration + scope, assets) is built from it. No CNAME/robots.txt is written when set (the root site owns them). Env override: SHATR_BASE_PATH.

cachePrefix.description: Prefix of every service-worker cache this site owns (the worker deletes only caches with this prefix, so apps sharing an origin do not wipe each other). Default: first label of domain (+ base path).

signature.description: Poet signature after every section (each), only after the last (last) or never (none). Single layout only.

continuousNumbering.description: Number the bayts 1..N across the whole poem instead of restarting in every section.

credits.description: Credits block under the link cards (recitation, sources …).
